newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Sampoerna unit buys 2.85 pct Astra stake.
newsitem.headline: Sampoerna unit buys 2.85 pct Astra stake.

text.p: Indonesian tobacco firm PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna said on Tuesday that its 100 percent subsidiary Sampoerna Investment Corporation had bought a 2.85 percent stake in vehicle manufacturer Astra International.
Sampoerna corporate development director Jonathan Zax said the stake was separate from the 9.81 percent holding in Astra bought by Sampoerna founder and president director Putera Sampoerna.
He said Sampoerna Investment had bought 33.18 million shares of Astra at a cost of 157.61 billion rupiah.
On Monday, Putera Sampoerna said he had bought 9.81 percent of Astra International at a cost of 435.88 billion rupiah ($189.51 million).
The purchase by Sampoerna Investment effectively makes him the largest shareholder in the country's biggest vehicle-maker, which has been dogged by rumours of a takeover bid for the past two weeks.
Timber tycoon Parjogo Pangestu holds a 10.68 percent stake in Astra while Toyota Motor Corp holds 8.26 percent.
Zax did not say when Sampoerna Investment bought the shares or from whom.
Sampoerna Investment, based in the British Virgin Islands, is 100 percent owned by Singapore-based Sampoerna International Pte. Ltd.
The Singapore-based company is owned 100 percent by PT Handjaya Mandala Sampoerna.
